about_the_game:
<h2> Woeful Barrows And Other Places for Shadowdark RPG</h2>
<p> A Shadowdark-compatible role-playing game adventure collection for level 1-5 characters.</p>
<p>
<b> The Queen of Brambles</b> : Elf-Queen Lia's crypt was recently rediscovered. Do you dare disturb her resting place?</p>
<p>
<b> Shune's Door</b> : In the hillside, a black steel door is etched with the diabolic glyph of Shune the Betrayer. What lies beyond?</p>
<p>
<b> Gorr's Tomb</b> : Hatlitt Gorr was a renowned dragon-slayer, but the dwarf warlord succumbed to the curse of his dragon-tainted gold. Seek gold and glory, or a quick death.</p>
<p>
<b> The Amber Chimera</b> : An old Elvish reflecting pool, a black obelisk, and a chimera carved from amber. Rumors talk about wealth, danger, and a gemstone beast that cannot die.</p>
<p>
<b> The Pale Vault</b> : The Ebon Heart, an arcane relic of immense power, was secured in the Pale Vault. Will you brave the vault's wards and acquire the wooden heart?</p>
<p>
<b> Finding Seph Bordel</b> : Persephone Bordel, fianc?e of Lord Oster, was kidnapped by her ex-lover. There's a substantial reward for rescuing her from her captors.</p>
<p>
<b> Tomb of Himortu</b> : The ancient elf-lord Himortu was buried with his arms and armor. Surely these antiquities belong in your capable hands - you just need to go get them.</p>
<p>
<b> Short Encounters</b> : A collection of 15 wilderness and 6 urban encounters, such as a dream wine speakeasy, prism-worshipping cultists, a trapped cave troll, hobgoblin bandit ambushes, eager grifters selling "magical trinkets," and many more.</p>
<p> The Woeful Barrows And Other Places includes:</p>
<ul> <li> Player and GM maps for all locations</li>
<li> Rumors and hooks for all locations</li>
<li> Random encounter tables</li>
<li> 16 new magic items</li>
<li> And more...</li>
</ul> <div> </div> "
